configurations.name: backend
configurations._why_pinned: V-188: DATABASE_URL is PINNED, not unset. The preview spawner's environment carried a production Neon URL and the source was never identified (V-189 cleared shell profiles, launchd, direnv, uv config/UV_* vars, and all three settings.json env blocks; backend/.env holds only Clerk keys; the value's home is collector/.env, which the nightly ledger legitimately needs, but uv does not load it for --project backend). Unsetting defends against one origin; pinning defends against any. The pin stays even if the source turns up later — a dev server that sits one env var away from production should be explicit, not ambient. V-149 refused the remote migration on boot, which is what caught this; the fix is to stop pointing dev at prod, never to set SKEPTIC_ALLOW_REMOTE_MIGRATION.
